title: 分屏布局
description: 一条中线，两种声音：左边说话，右边给证据。一支 20 秒短片，全片只有一个主角——中线：它画下来，把“Split”像拉链一样拉合；章节像两条反向的传送带翻页，左半向上、右半向下；中线滑过 50:50、62:38、70:30，文字跟着重新折行；明暗、图文、静动三对反差从中线向两边撕开；一边固定、一边滚动，再反过来；浏览器窄过 768px 的一刻，整条中线转 90°，左右变成上下。

descriptionEn: One dividing line, two voices: the left half makes the statement, the right half gives the evidence. A 20-second film with a single protagonist — the line: it is drawn, then zips the word "Split" together; chapters turn pages like two conveyor belts, the left half sliding up while the right half slides down; the line glides through 50:50, 62:38 and 70:30 as text reflows for real; light/dark, image/text and still/motion tear open from the line; one half pins while the other scrolls, then the directions reverse; and when a browser window narrows below 768px, the whole line rotates 90 degrees and left/right becomes top/bottom.
